title: Staff per office city
statementMd:
How many employees work in each department location (city)? Show the city and the count.

Expected columns: `location`, `staff`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Group by `d.location`; two departments can share a city.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT d.location, COUNT(*) AS staff FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.location;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
